mapper.select: INSERT INTO login_user (platform, app_id, anchor_open_id, nickname, avatar_url, login_ip) VALUES (#{platform}, #{appId}, #{anchorOpenId}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{loginIp}) ON CONFLICT (platform, app_id, anchor_open_id) DO UPDATE SET nickname = EXCLUDED.nickname, avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url, login_ip = EXCLUDED.login_ip, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id, platform, account, app_id, anchor_open_id, nickname, avatar_url, login_ip, created_at, updated_at

WITH new_user AS ( SELECT nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('login_user', 'id')) AS id ) INSERT INTO login_user (id, platform, account, app_id, anchor_open_id, nickname, avatar_url, login_ip) SELECT id, #{platform}, #{account}, #{appId}, CAST(id AS VARCHAR), #{account}, '', #{loginIp} FROM new_user ON CONFLICT (account) DO UPDATE SET nickname = EXCLUDED.nickname, login_ip = EXCLUDED.login_ip, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id, platform, account, app_id, anchor_open_id, nickname, avatar_url, login_ip, created_at, updated_at
